ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 10-15% high-intensity (white) localized features and medium-intensity (gray) central mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white circular and annular spots distributed across both lobes; an irregular, vertically elongated medium-gray patch located centrally below the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approximately 85-90 degree V-shaped notch with a distinct vertex and moderate vertical depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous sequence of irregular peaks and valleys with varying pixel-amplitudes, most pronounced on the right lobe trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Generally convex curve fitted to the trailing edge of both lobes, terminating in highly irregular, jagged distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous high-contrast circular and ring-like clusters (rosette patterns) visible across the mid-to-outer regions of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent diagonal white linear mark on the upper-mid right lobe; several smaller, randomly oriented white linear marks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Highly irregular, textured protrusions at the extreme distal tips of both lobes indicating heavy barnacle colonization or significant previous trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique central mottled gray region contrasting sharply with the uniform dark pigmentation of the surrounding fluke surface.
